notes: No genuine Clearance/Outlet-style PLP exists on this site. Checked: main nav + mega menus (New/Furniture/Decor/Window/Bedding/Outdoor/Fabric/Inspiration/Free Swatches/Trade -- no Clearance/Outlet item), full footer link list, the /categories full category index page (76 links, none matching clear/outlet/final/last chance/end of line/discontinu*), and sitemap.xml's sitemap-index (34 per-product-type sitemaps, e.g. sitemap-beds.xml, sitemap-outdoor.xml -- none named clearance/outlet/sale). Tried direct guesses /collections/clearance, /collections/outlet, /collections/final-sale -- all 301-redirect to a soft-404 (theinside.com/404.html), i.e. the handles don't exist. Site's own search (?q=clearance / ?q=outlet / ?q=final+sale) returns the identical 'FOUND 75,321 ITEMS' catalog-wide result for every query verbatim (confirmed non-discriminating -- classic false-absence search widget), so it was not used as evidence of absence, only nav/sitemap/categories were. The one candidate found, /collections/sale (linked nowhere in nav but resolves 200), was opened and rejected as Clearance: page title 'On Sale Now | The Inside by Havenly', on-page heading 'Currently On Sale', description 'On sale now: our favorite accent pieces, including select rugs, throw blankets, accent tables, and lamps. Prices are shown on product page. Additional discounts do not apply.' -- this reads as a small curated temporary promotional sale (7 products, mixed accent-decor styles), not a permanent-markdown/outlet listing; no 'clearance', 'outlet', 'final sale', 'last chance', or 'end of line' language appears anywhere on the page, in its title, or in any nav/breadcrumb pointing to it. Per the Sale-vs-Clearance test in the brief this is excluded, not flagged ambiguous, because there is no permanence signal at all pointing the other way -- it is unambiguously framed as a temporary sale event (site-wide banner elsewhere reads 'ONCE UPON A TIME, YOU SAVED 25% OFF SITEWIDE' and a popup 'Enjoy 25% Off Sitewide -- You're just in time. The sale is on.', confirming /collections/sale is simply the product-listing view of that same site-wide promotional discount, not a distinct clearance concept).
